definitions.overwritten_before_read: In straight-line solve a local name is assigned twice before any read
definitions.unreachable_after_return: Statements after unconditional return/raise, including if/else with both branches terminating
definitions.terminal_assignment_return: solve ends with name = expression; return name (adjacent AST statements)
definitions.terminal_name_alias_return: Narrower case: solve ends with name = other_name; return name
definitions.docstrings: Module or solve has a docstring
definitions.comments: Python tokenize detects a COMMENT token; comments are absent from AST
definitions.redundant_pass: A statement block has pass plus at least one other statement
definitions.unused_literal_expression: Standalone literal expression other than a leading docstring
definitions.dynamic_namespace: Namespace reflection/eval/exec/frame access detected; unused-import/local checks are suppressed
definitions.straight_line_solve: Local backward slice applies: only simple assignments, literals, pass, and one final return
